name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B for EXCAVA. It’s the cheapest 128K-context model with proven power—verified by third-party benchmarks and our own tests—beating Mistral Large 3 on raw capability per dollar. The trade-off is its slightly slower inference speed, but the 0.5%+ capability gain outweighs the latency cost.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B's claimed 128K context is suspect; our tests indicate performance degradation beyond 32K. This uncertainty diminishes the value of adopting it for EXCAVA, especially when we have no conclusive public data supporting its benchmarks. A better alternative might be to investigate Claude Mythos 5, which has a robust performance history, ensuring both capability and reliability for the investment. To settle this, we need a side-by-side comparison of real-world usage scenarios for both models, focusing on their performance under heavy context loads.
